rows.description: Starting with its arm raised, the robot performs a quick preparatory dip before thrusting its fist powerfully upward, holding the peak pose, and finishing with a triumphant shake.
From a neutral mid-chest position, the robot arm pulls back slightly in anticipation before thrusting upward in a fast, triumphant fist pump, holding at the apex.
Starting with the arm extended to the side, the robot quickly curls its elbow up in a classic bicep flex, holds the pose, then gives a small, triumphant shake.
Starting with its arm already raised, the robot performs a quick upward and outward lift from the shoulder, holds briefly, then relaxes back down, mimicking a classic 'I don't know' shrug.
From its left side, the robot raises its arm to its head and pauses in thought, then scratches its head a few times with a confused motion.
Starting with its arm raised, the robot sharply rotates its wrist to orient the gripper like a palm, then quickly brings it to its 'face' and holds it there in a classic facepalm gesture.
From a resting position behind its back, the robot arm swings around to the front, pauses, and then points sharply at its own chest.
Starting from a neutral position with a vertical gripper, the arm thrusts sharply forward to point directly at the viewer, holding the pose for emphasis.
From an extended forward position, the robot curls its wrist inward twice with a distinct rhythm to beckon someone closer.
Starting with its arm raised, the robot pulls back slightly before sharply pushing its gripper forward in a definitive 'stop' gesture, holding the final pose.
Starting from its left, the robot arm moves to the center of its body and makes several slow, circular pats on its stomach.
Starting with the arm raised to the side, the wrist rapidly oscillates side-to-side to mimic fanning the face due to heat, then slows slightly as if catching a breath.
From a raised position, the arm slowly lifts the gripper to cover a 'mouth' for a yawn, holds it, then lets it droop down slightly in a sleepy finish.
From a raised position to the side of its head, the robot slowly rubs in a small circle, then lets its arm slump down tiredly.
Starting with the arm extended left, it pulls in slightly to position the gripper by the temple, then performs two quick taps to signify thinking.
From a starting position at its side, the robot arm traces two small, quick vertical circles in the air to signify 'crazy' or 'thinking hard'.
Starting from a neutral forward position, the robot arm smoothly extends further forward and slightly upward, holding the pose to show curiosity and focused attention.
From a raised position, the arm jerks inward quickly to cover the 'mouth' area, holding the position to signify a sudden gasp or shock.
Starting in a raised 'toast' position, the arm thrusts forward for a sharp 'clink', gives a small celebratory shake, and then retracts.
Starting with the arm raised in a classic high-five position, the robot makes two small, encouraging upward nods with its wrist to invite a high-five.
Starting with its arm raised in a ready position, the robot performs a quick forward 'slap' motion, holds briefly at full extension, and then recoils to the starting pose to simulate a high-five.
The robot extends its arm forward in a fistbump offer, then gives two small, encouraging vertical pumps to invite a response.
Starting with its arm already behind its back, the robot gives itself three quick, encouraging pats.
Starting with the arm extended to the left, the robot executes a fast, sharp horizontal slice across its body and holds abruptly, then adds a small downward flick to punctuate the 'stop' gesture.
Starting with the arm extended forward, the robot snaps its hand up to a formal salute position near its head, holds it, and then lowers the arm.
Starting with the hand held to the side of the head like a visor, the arm sweeps smoothly across the front in a straight line, pauses as if processing information, then sweeps back to the start.
From a neutral forward pose with a horizontal gripper, the robot arm performs a smooth, outward sweeping arc to politely signal 'after you' or yield a turn.
Starting with the arm raised and gripper held flat like a platter, the robot makes a smooth, crisp sweep to the side and holds, clearly indicating that it is someone else's turn.
Starting with the arm extended forward and the hand vertical, the robot makes a smooth, deliberate sweep to the side to guide or indicate a direction.
Starting from a raised-guard position, the arm thrusts forward and slightly down in a sharp, protective blocking motion, holding the final position.
From a high forward position with the gripper horizontal (palm down), the robot performs two gentle, slow, downward pats in the air to request 'slow down'.
From a neutral forward position, the arm extends directly forward with firm speed, then holds steady in a classic handshake or item-acceptance gesture.
Starting from a high forward position with a horizontal gripper, the robot's wrist performs two quick, small down-and-up beats to signal a 'yes' nod.
From a raised forward position, the robot's wrist shakes side-to-side in a clear, repeated motion to signal 'no'.
From a forward-facing position, the robot's arm performs two quick wrist flicks, separated by a distinct pause, to signify 'air quotes'.
From a neutral forward position, the robot's gripper slowly tilts to the side and holds, mimicking a curious head tilt.
Starting with its arm raised, the robot brings its gripper forward in a smooth motion, as if placing a finger to its lips to signal for quiet.
From a raised position, the arm lifts higher and slightly forward, then pitches the gripper up to present a flat 'palm' in a classic hands-up surrender gesture.
From an arm extended to the left, the robot pushes its hand further outward in a straight line with a firm hold, defining an expanded boundary.
